## What problem does this solve?

trying to do, and what got in the way?

you can.

## Where does it fit in the flow?

Which part of the migration does this touch? (Check all that apply.)

- [ ] Upload / connecting YNAB
- [ ] Reviewing and selecting accounts
- [ ] Naming accounts / setting types and subtypes
- [ ] Manual CSV download
- [ ] Mapping accounts, columns, categories, or tags
- [ ] Import priority / duplicate handling

## Additional context

Screenshots, mockups, links, or anything else that helps explain the request.
